correctness.rationale: The exact 18 Frucht edges are provided and the script checks isomorphism to the canonical 12-vertex LCF model. A face is precisely a vertex subset with internal induced degree≤1. Independent bitmask enumeration of all 2^12 subsets gives 824 nonempty faces and f-vector (12,66,190,293,209,53,1). The frozen script was inspected function-by-function: deterministic vertex matching, full directed Hasse acyclicity topological sort of every incidence, exact signed boundary reductions in degree 4→3, signed integral 3-cycle lifting and projection to full Morse generators. It yields 410 matched pairs in the full case with one critical 0-cell, two critical 3-cells and one critical 4-cell; integer differential (0,1), so K≃S³. Each deletion has only a 0-cell and b_v 3-cells except v=8 where the remaining 4-cell has integral unit boundary. Thus each deletion genuinely has a wedge-of-three-spheres homotopy model, not just Betti numbers. The signed integral projection gives zero images on v∈{0,6,8,9}, and primitive unit coefficient elsewhere. Independently reconstructed 825 total faces including the empty face, every mod-2 Betti rank and each of the twelve mod-2 inclusion images (all consistent with the integral calculation). Mod-2 evidence alone does not prove Z-surjectivity, which rests on the examined integer cycle lifts.
